review_basis: the user approved SypherPK as a source for 812; each upload is still judged on its own: genuinely Fortnite, a complete programme, duration, not a Short, not a passing reference, not unrelated gaming, not a duplicate, not repetitive clickbait, programme type, provenance and hard rules

decisions.reason: Complete 14-minute tournament run on controller; wholly Fortnite competitive gameplay with the creator's commentary.
Complete 18-minute challenge playing each Fortnite chapter's loadout against the others; Fortnite throughout and less tied to one season than most uploads.
Complete 20-minute match story; Fortnite gameplay throughout. Superlative title, but it describes the match rather than baiting a rumour.
Complete 27-minute gameplay programme on a season's mechanics; Fortnite throughout. Season-specific, so a later review should rotate it out when Season 4 is long past.
Complete 17-minute comeback match; Fortnite gameplay throughout. Second "in Fortnite History" superlative from the source, accepted because the content differs; a third would be held as repetition.

Complete 27-minute creator challenge built on Fortnite's Sprite feature with other Fortnite creators; Fortnite throughout. The only Sprite programme on 812 (the Top5Gaming Sprite items stay with their held source).
10-minute opinion on where the game is heading, dated August 2026; commentary that ages within a season. Hold rather than reject: suitable for a short-lived recent slot if 812 ever has one.
"Fortnite Messed Up...": the title does not say what the programme is, and no description is available; it may be a complaint about an update. Needs viewing before a decision.
